mesh.create_network_tips: Create an Mesh network for seamless Wi-Fi coverage at home.
mesh.add_nodes_tips: Add mesh nodes to your Mesh network, and expand Wi-Fi coverage at home.
mesh.join_network_tips: Join your Mesh network to connect to the main router's network.
mesh.select_mode_title: Select the mode for this router
mesh.main_router_desc: This mode connects to the Internet and manages all Mesh Nodes.
mesh.mesh_node_desc: This mode extends the Wi-Fi coverage of the Main Router locally.
mesh.wifi_scan_desc: Scan for nearby nodes to expand your Mesh network.
mesh.wifi_scan_prepare_tips: Please ensure the new node is powered on, ready for pairing, and placed within Wi-Fi coverage of the main router before scanning.
mesh.ethernet_backhaul_prepare_tips: Connect the powered-on node's WAN port to the main router via Ethernet cable. The system will auto-configure.
mesh.ethernet_backhaul_instruction_title: Connect Mesh Node using an Ethernet cable to build a stable Ethernet Backhaul network.
mesh.ethernet_backhaul_step_one: 1. Power on the target Mesh Node.
mesh.ethernet_backhaul_step_two: 2. Plug one end of an Ethernet cable into the {wan} of the target Mesh Node, and the other end into the {lan} of the Main Router.
mesh.ethernet_backhaul_step_three: 3. The system will automatically detect the Mesh Node and complete the configuration.
mesh.reset_mode_tips1: Are you sure you want to reset the Mesh network?
mesh.reset_mode_tips2: All current Mesh settings will be cleared, and the Mesh Nodes will be reset to factory settings.
mesh.join_by_wifi_scan_new_tips: Please access your Main Router's admin panel and use the "Wi-Fi Scan" option on the Mesh menu to add Mesh Node.
mesh.add_mesh_node_by_wifi_scan: Add Mesh Node By Wi-Fi Scan
mesh.select_add_the_devices_tips: The following nodes were found. Select the devices you want to add to your Mesh network.
mesh.join_by_ethernet_cable_new_tips: Connect the Mesh Node's WAN port to the Main Router using an Ethernet cable to automatically configure an Ethernet Backhaul network.
mesh.node_added_successfully_desc: The node will appear in the topology shortly. For best performance, place it halfway between the main router and any Wi-Fi dead zone.
mesh.reboot_device_tips: Are you sure you want to reboot this device?
mesh.remove_device_tips: Are you sure you want to remove this device?
mesh.do_not_power_off_tips: Do not power off or operate the node during this process.
mesh.you_can_check_node_tips: You can check the firmware version in the node information page once complete.
mesh.mesh_node_mode_tips: The device is currently in Mesh Node mode. You can log in to the Main Router's admin panel to manage it.
mesh.wifi_scan_unavailable_repeater_dfs_tips: The current repeater is connected to a DFS channel, preventing Wi-Fi scanning.
mesh.wifi_scan_unavailable_router_dfs_tips: When the router is operating on a DFS channel, Wi-Fi scanning cannot function.
mesh.pairing_code_unavailable_repeater_dfs_ti: The current repeater is connected to a DFS channel, so pairing code cannot be used to add nodes.
mesh.pairing_code_unavailable_router_dfs_tips: When the router is operating on a DFS channel, pairing code cannot be used to add nodes.
mesh.disable_repeater_scan_notice_tips: Disabling the repeater will allow scanning to continue. After the scan, you will need to reconnect the repeater manually.
mesh.switch_channel_scan_notice_tips: Switching to a non-DFS channel is required to scan for nodes. This process may take a few moments.
mesh.disable_repeater_pairing_code_notice_tip: Disabling the repeater will allow you to add nodes via pairing codes. Afterwards, you will need to reconnect the repeater manually.
mesh.switch_channel_pairing_code_notice_tips: To add nodes via pairing codes, switching to a non-DFS channel is required. This process may take a few moments.
mesh.wifi_scan_unavailable_disabled_repeater_: 5G Wi-Fi is currently disabled, and the repeater is connected to a DFS channel, preventing Wi-Fi scanning.
mesh.wifi_scan_unavailable_hidden_repeater_df: 5G Wi-Fi is currently hidden, and the repeater is connected to a DFS channel, preventing Wi-Fi scanning.
mesh.wifi_scan_unavailable_hidden_tips: 5G Wi-Fi is currently hidden, preventing Wi-Fi scanning.
mesh.show_5g_main_wifi_notice_tips: Showing 5G Wi-Fi is required to scan for nodes.This process may take a few moments.
mesh.wifi_scan_unavailable_disabled_tips: 5G Wi-Fi is currently disabled, preventing Wi-Fi scanning.
mesh.enable_5g_main_wifi_notice_tips: Enabling 5G Wi-Fi is required to scan for nodes.This process may take a few moments.
mesh.enable_5g_main_wifi_disable_repeater_not: To continue scanning, you need to enable 5G Wi-Fi and disable the repeater.After the scan, you will need to reconnect the repeater manually.
mesh.show_5g_main_wifi_disable_repeater_notic: To continue scanning, you need to show 5G Wi-Fi and disable the repeater.After the scan, you will need to reconnect the repeater manually.
mesh.ensure_mesh_supported_tips: Ensure Mesh is supported and enabled, and move the device closer to the main router if needed.
mesh.make_sure_device_powered_tips: Make sure the device you want to add is powered on and within range of the Main Router.
mesh.wifi_scan_failed_secondary_tips: Make sure Mesh is enabled on the peer device, move it closer to the main router, then try again.
